{{Quote|This is Hammer 3:2. We require a tech team up here as quickly as possible. Nothing major, but our port repulsors need looking at.|Sergeant Arbmab|<ref name="The Assault on Protazk">{{WEGCite|story=The Assault on Protazk|book=Imperial Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''Arbmab''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and crewman of [[Hammer 3:2]], a [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] in the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]]. He fought at the [[Assault on Protazk]] during the [[Kwymar Suppressions/Legends|Kwymar Suppressions]].

==Biography==
Arbmab was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] serving in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was assigned to the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]], known colloquially as "Hell's Hammers," and commanded [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] [[Hammer 3:2]] alongside his driver, [[Gortz]]. He participated in the [[Assault on Protazk|assault]] on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Protazk]]<ref name="Protazk" /> during the [[Kwymar Suppressions/Legends|Kwymar Suppressions]].<ref name="Hunt">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin1|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1}}</ref> During the assault, Hammer 3:2 took minor damage to the its port [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] which required a tech team to look at.<ref name="Protazk" />
